title: skills(objectstack-ui): the dashboards rule says Postgres buckets with date_trunc; the SQL driver groups by to_char(... AT TIME ZONE UTC) on Postgres
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect on a shipped surface: one wrongly stated sentence in a published skill** (North Star item 4). The reach is the shipped skill text, measured against the driver.

**Position.** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` line 326, on `origin/main`:

> * **Engine support** — Postgres `date_trunc`, MySQL `date_format`, SQLite `strftime`, MongoDB `$dateTrunc`, in-memory fallback.

**What the driver does.** `SqlDriver.buildDateBucketExpr` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`) buckets on PostgreSQL with `to_char((col)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM')`, not `date_trunc`. This was measured on PostgreSQL 16.14 during #21441 (os-dev report on #21441, PR #21587). The bucket keys are strings such as `2026-01`, where a `date_trunc` echo answers `2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`.
- Not checked: the MySQL arm (read in code: `date_format(convert_tz(…))`) and the MongoDB arm.

**Why it matters.** The skill is the authoring surface agents read. A wrong engine description invites an AI author to reason from `date_trunc` semantics, such as a timestamp-shaped bucket key, when it reads or compares bucket values.

**Who acts.** Triage routes this. `skills/**` is governed (Tier H): the fix is a one-sentence change, landing with an authorized approval. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118), session `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`, from #21441's report. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Duplicate check.** Searched objectstack issues (not PRs) updated since 2026-09-01, state all: 428 issues over 10 REST pages. ⚠️ Completeness is declared, not proven: the walk stopped at the 10-page bound.
- `date_trunc`: 1 hit, #21441 (the echo, a different position).
- `dashboards.md`: 2 hits, #21211 (closed, the compareTo override) and #21131 (closed, unread widget keys). Both are other sentences.
- Positive control: `skills/`, 31 hits.

Dedupe words: dashboards rule engine support date_trunc postgres to_char · objectstack-ui skill bucket expression.
